newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Producer sells May Tapis at quotes +40 cts - traders.
newsitem.headline: Producer sells May Tapis at quotes +40 cts - traders.

text.p: A producer sold 400,000 barrels of mid-May Tapis crude oil at published Tapis quotes plus 40 cents per barrel, market sources said on Thursday.
The barrels were sold to a Japanese trader for selling into China, the sources said.
The deal represents the first Tapis deal on the basis of published quotes for several weeks, possibly since early March, traders said.
Traders said the price achieved by the producer was in line with where they had assessed the market.
Most recent deals have been concluded on the basis of official selling prices because of the difficulty of assessing the crude against Tapis swaps levels.
The premium has plummeted in the past two months from higher than $1.40.
